user.title: Set up Woow ESPHome Modbus Scanner
user.description: Experimental local build. Leave both fields empty for mock only. Physical scanning requires the Guanjie read-only bridge v1 firmware; configuring an ordinary ESPHome node does not add that capability. Physical scans are available through services; the sidebar retains its upstream mock workflow. All authenticated HA users can invoke scan services.

error.gateway_pair_required: Provide both host and MAC, or leave both empty.
error.invalid_mac: Enter a MAC address in AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF format.
